context: 2026-10-05 readiness slice uses the existing NotionSettings, read_page transport and a temporary ledger, without importing the router or initializing persistence. It follows existing validation/error handling conventions; no dependency or tool-definition changes.

An existing Notion approval/reject regression was flaky because its TestClient closed the run event loop between requests. Reusing the adversarial tests' persistent-portal pattern fixes the test only; production behavior is unchanged.
This is a public-safe projection of the owning records, not a second roadmap or blanket execution permission.
Historical DL-01 through DL-14 finding IDs and evidence are preserved. Untouched UI and infrastructure findings remain historical, not newly verified.

PR #48 merged the Notion adapter; #51 added generic preflight; #52 fixed overlapping file edits; #53 added static revalidation; #54 fixed a deadline-test GC flake; #55 records the unqualified H9 run and runner correction.
DaveLLM runtime uses native /api/chat; the governing H9 fixed runner uses /v1/chat/completions. Their evidence is not interchangeable.
Approval state and Notion ledgers remain per-process and per-run. No process-restart durability is claimed.
DaveHarness remains 1.0.0-rc.1 and DaveLLM remains 2.1.0. No tag, release, qualification or human acceptance is claimed.
